tool_markers.T1595.003: wordlist scanners (gobuster, DirBuster, dirb, Wfuzz, ffuf, feroxbuster)

limitations: Encrypted HTTP and absent body content cannot be judged.
At most two percent-decoding passes; a third level of encoding is not decoded.
A value is read up to 16,384 characters and a record up to 65,536; what lies beyond is not inspected and the record is counted partial.
Session URI lists do not prove transaction counts or association with status or user-agent.
Every class remains lead; 2xx does not establish exploitation.
Finite vocabularies do not cover every attack or tool.
A bare ambiguous command name after a delimiter that follows a word (host=localhost;id) is read as a list item.
A remote script URL (.php, .jsp, .aspx) on another named host in page=, file=, path= or template= is not reported without an IP-literal host or a trailing '?' or NUL.
The login rate does not see slow guessing, guessing spread over many sources, or failure statuses on paths outside the sign-in vocabulary.
